claims.text: Web Search Plus adds web search and page extraction tools to Hermes, with routing and fallback across configured providers.

evidence.quote:
**Give your Hermes agent better web search and clean page reading.** Web Search Plus connects several search services behind one simple setup. It returns the original links and pages, can try another service when one fails, and works with just one configured provider.

It adds two Hermes tools:

- `web_search_plus` — search the web and return useful sources
- `web_extract_plus` — read and clean the pages you already have

> Ported from [web-search-plus-plugin](https://github.com/robbyczgw-cla/web-search-plus-plugin) for the [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) plugin API.

claims.text: Optional Jev confirms inferred news searches, judges extracted page quality and fills a missing language; it does not retrieve search results.

evidence.quote:
### What's new in 4.2.0

Optional **Jev** can confirm a `news` search type, score extract bodies, and fill language when WSP inferred none. It is not a search provider and stays **off** until you pass `setup --jev`.

- Search-type overlay: keywords may propose `news`; Jev confirms only at confidence ≥ 0.95; otherwise the request stays `search`. Explicit `--search-type news` is unchanged.
- Extract quality: Jev may keep a long page that looked like a bot wall, or reject chrome.
- Language fill: only when WSP inferred none.

Keep the key in `TYPESAFE_API_KEY_FILE` (mode 600), never in `config.json`. If you enable Jev, install `typesafe-sdk` separately — the plugin stays stdlib-only. See the [4.2.0 release notes](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V420.md).

claims.text: Install the Hermes plugin and configure a search provider. Enable Jev separately with setup --jev and install typesafe-sdk.

evidence.quote:
## Quick Start

```bash
# 1) Install and enable the plugin
hermes plugins install robbyczgw-cla/hermes-web-search-plus --enable

# 2) Inspect provider readiness and configure the providers you use
python3 ~/.hermes/plugins/web-search-plus/setup.py status
python3 ~/.hermes/plugins/web-search-plus/setup.py setup --preset starter

# 3) Reload Hermes so the tools are registered
# CLI: exit and start `hermes` again, or use /reset in-session
# Gateway: /restart, then /reset

# 4) Optional shell smoke test
cd ~/.hermes/plugins/web-search-plus
python3 search.py --query "Hermes Agent latest release" --provider auto --quality-report
```

Web Search Plus supports 15 search and 9 extraction providers — you do **not** need them all. One search-capable key or configured local endpoint enables `web_search_plus`; one extraction-capable key or endpoint enables `web_extract_plus`; more providers just make controlled routing more flexible. The setup helper stores keys in the active Hermes environment file — never commit them to the repository.

Optional Jev stays off unless you pass `--jev`:

```bash
python3 ~/.hermes/plugins/web-search-plus/setup.py setup --preset lean \
  --jev --jev-key-file "$HOME/.hermes/secrets/typesafe_api_key"

claims.text: Jev is off by default and requires its own key-file setup. Provider privacy and retention terms differ, so enabling one route does not establish the same terms for all.

evidence.quote:
Optional **Jev** can confirm a `news` search type, score extract bodies, and fill language when WSP inferred none. It is not a search provider and stays **off** until you pass `setup --jev`.

- Search-type overlay: keywords may propose `news`; Jev confirms only at confidence ≥ 0.95; otherwise the request stays `search`. Explicit `--search-type news` is unchanged.
- Extract quality: Jev may keep a long page that looked like a bot wall, or reject chrome.
- Language fill: only when WSP inferred none.

Keep the key in `TYPESAFE_API_KEY_FILE` (mode 600), never in `config.json`. If you enable Jev, install `typesafe-sdk` separately — the plugin stays stdlib-only. See the [4.2.0 release notes](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V420.md).

Provider privacy is not uniform. Before sending sensitive queries or URLs, review the maintained [Provider Privacy & Terms guide](https://websearchplus.xyz/providers.html#privacy-terms), which distinguishes standard self-serve terms from enterprise-only ZDR or no-training options.

sections.heading: Phạm vi và giới hạn
sections.text: Jev mặc định tắt và cần tệp khóa riêng. Điều khoản riêng tư, lưu giữ khác nhau giữa nhà cung cấp.

tr.title: hermes-web-search-plus — İsteğe bağlı Jev denetimli Hermes araması
tr.h1: hermes-web-search-plus — İsteğe bağlı Jev denetimli Hermes araması
tr.description: hermes-web-search-plus: İsteğe bağlı Jev, çıkarılan haber arama türünü doğrular, sayfa kalitesini değerlendirir ve eksik dili tamamlar; sonuçları getirmez.
tr.summary: Web Search Plus, Hermes’e yapılandırılmış sağlayıcılar arasında yönlendirme ve yedeklemeyle arama ve sayfa çıkarma ekler. Eklentiyi ve arama sağlayıcısını kurup setup --jev ile Jev’i ayrıca açın ve typesafe-sdk yükleyin.

sections.heading: Ne işe yarar
sections.text: Web Search Plus, Hermes’e yapılandırılmış sağlayıcılar arasında yönlendirme ve yedeklemeyle arama ve sayfa çıkarma ekler.

sections.heading: Jev’in rolü
sections.text: İsteğe bağlı Jev, çıkarılan haber arama türünü doğrular, sayfa kalitesini değerlendirir ve eksik dili tamamlar; sonuçları getirmez.

sections.heading: Başlangıç
sections.text: Eklentiyi ve arama sağlayıcısını kurup setup --jev ile Jev’i ayrıca açın ve typesafe-sdk yükleyin.

sections.heading: Kapsam ve sınırlar
sections.text: Jev varsayılan olarak kapalıdır ve anahtar dosyası ister. Gizlilik ve saklama şartları sağlayıcıya göre değişir.

it.title: hermes-web-search-plus — Ricerca Hermes con controlli Jev facoltativi
it.h1: hermes-web-search-plus — Ricerca Hermes con controlli Jev facoltativi
it.description: hermes-web-search-plus: Jev facoltativo conferma ricerche di notizie dedotte, valuta l’estrazione e completa la lingua mancante; non recupera risultati.
it.summary: Web Search Plus aggiunge ricerca ed estrazione di pagine a Hermes, con instradamento e ripiego tra fornitori configurati. Installa il plugin e un fornitore di ricerca, poi attiva Jev con setup --jev e installa typesafe-sdk.

sections.heading: A cosa serve
sections.text: Web Search Plus aggiunge ricerca ed estrazione di pagine a Hermes, con instradamento e ripiego tra fornitori configurati.

sections.heading: Ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Jev facoltativo conferma ricerche di notizie dedotte, valuta l’estrazione e completa la lingua mancante; non recupera risultati.

sections.heading: Come iniziare
sections.text: Installa il plugin e un fornitore di ricerca, poi attiva Jev con setup --jev e installa typesafe-sdk.

sections.heading: Ambito e limiti
sections.text: Jev è disattivato inizialmente e richiede un file chiave. Privacy e conservazione variano da fornitore a fornitore.
